q: In an ideal fluid, the mass flowing in section 1 must _____ the mass flowing in section 2.
e: In an ideal fluid, the mass flowing in section 1 must equal the mass flowing in section 2. exceed or be less than is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The volume flow rate is _____ throughout the pipe.
e: The volume flow rate is the same throughout the pipe. variable or decreasing is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The equation $A_1 v_1 = A_2 v_2$ is known as the equation of _____ for fluid flow.
e: The equation A₁ v₁ = A₂ v₂ is known as the equation of continuity for fluid flow. The continuity equation A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ keeps volume flow rate constant, so a narrower section has a larger speed. Bernoulli or Stokes is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: According to the equation of continuity, the larger the area of the pipe, the _____ is the speed.
e: According to the equation of continuity, the larger the area of the pipe, the slower is the speed. Continuity: a larger pipe area gives a slower flow speed. faster or constant is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: According to the equation of continuity, the smaller the area of the pipe, the _____ is the speed.
e: According to the equation of continuity, the smaller the area of the pipe, the faster is the speed. The continuity equation A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ keeps volume flow rate constant, so a narrower section has a larger speed. slower or zero is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The equation of continuity states that the liquid entering one end of the pipe leaves from the other end with a constant _____ flow rate.
e: The equation of continuity states that the liquid entering one end of the pipe leaves from the other end with a constant volume flow rate. Volume flow rate Av is constant for an incompressible liquid in a pipe. mass or density is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In the equation of continuity, $V/t$ represents the _____ flow rate.
e: In the equation of continuity, V/t represents the volume flow rate. Volume flow rate Av is constant for an incompressible liquid in a pipe. mass or weight is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: If the cross-sectional area of a pipe decreases, the speed of the liquid _____.
e: If the cross-sectional area of a pipe decreases, the speed of the liquid increases. decreases or remains constant is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The equation $A_1 v_1 = A_2 v_2$ applies to an ideal fluid which must have laminar flow and no _____.
e: The equation A₁ v₁ = A₂ v₂ applies to an ideal fluid which must have laminar flow and no viscosity. Viscosity is shear stress divided by velocity gradient, η = (F/A)/(dv/dy). pressure or density is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The density of an ideal fluid in the equation of continuity is _____.
e: The density of an ideal fluid in the equation of continuity is constant. The continuity equation A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ keeps volume flow rate constant, so a narrower section has a larger speed. variable or zero is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The speed of water spraying from a hose increases by making the hose area _____.
e: The speed of water spraying from a hose increases by making the hose area smaller. A smaller nozzle area raises the exit speed because Av stays constant. larger or longer is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: In the equation $A_1 v_1 = A_2 v_2$, the terms $v_1$ and $v_2$ represent the _____ of the liquid.
e: In the equation A₁ v₁ = A₂ v₂, the terms v₁ and v₂ represent the speed of the liquid. Speed is the magnitude of velocity. viscosity or volume is a different idea, so those options are wrong.

q: The equation of continuity is a manifestation of the conservation of _____.
e: The equation of continuity is a manifestation of the conservation of mass. Continuity of an incompressible fluid keeps mass flow the same at every section. energy or momentum is a different idea, so those options are wrong.
